educationalGoal: Various issues in engineering, science and social science are often described by differential equations. Students will learn how to solve 1st order ordinary differential equations (ODEs), 2nd order constant-coefficient linear ODEs and systems of simultaneous linear ODEs, and will understand (1) how to construct mathematical models of phenomena, (2) solution method and geometrical concept and (3) how to analyze solution properties and characteristics. Students will learn the fundamentals of programming to develop the generic ability to analyze physical phenomena.
advice:
In the class, the students will learn differential equations (ODEs): (1) 1st order ODEs, (2) 2nd order constant-coefficient linear ODEs (homogeneous and inhomogeneous ODEs), and (3) systems of 1st order simultaneous linear ODEs. The students will learn the following analytical methods:
(I) How to express physical and social phenomena with ODEs (construction of mathematical models).
(II) How to solve specific types of ODEs and how to think geometrically about phenomena by means of solution curves and direction fields.
(III) Analytical methods in which students will analyze obtained solutions and acquire information pertinent to the activities of engineers such as the pattern and the speed of changes in various phenomena.
After the student learn the main themes of ODEs, the students will apply the above knowledge (I), (II), and (III) to computing projects by using formula manipulation system, and submit a report of their results.
In the class, the students will use MATLAB in the following activities:
1) Visualizing the solutions for ODEs and thinking geometrically.
2) Setting and evaluating the parameters of ODEs.
3) Modeling physical phenomena and deriving and analyzing their solutions.
Therefore, the students should install MATLAB on individual notebook computer, and should master basic usage of MATLAB beforehand.

Be able to construct 2nd order linear ODEs for various phenomena and obtain the solutions.
Be able to construct simultaneous systems of 1st order ODEs for various phenomena and obtain the solutions.
Be able to analyze solutions obtained from ODEs and evaluate the pattern and speed of changes in phenomena.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the concept of ODEs and accurately explain the geometric properties of the solutions.
(2) Construct accurate mathematical models with ODEs from scientific and social phenomena.
(3) Accurately analyze the structure of ODEs and select an appropriate solution method.
(4) Draw the graph of the solution of an ODEs and clearly explain the behavior of the solution.
(5) Accurately analyze the behavior of solutions, predict future states of a phenomenon, obtain optimal solutions, and explain the reason for the predictions.
(6) Understand and successfully complete all homework.
